verdict.rationale: JumpCloud is an API-driven SaaS directory and identity platform, so a sandbox or test environment isolated from production data is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence covers APIs, the PowerShell module, bulk operations and support scripts, but nothing documents a sandbox or test org separate from production. Those API building blocks are not a sandbox capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
